# Manus Future QA Test Cases — Derived from Phase 1–2 Evidence

**Use policy.** These are **future manual/product QA specifications**, not an executed E2E framework and not a statement that the referenced behavior is globally deterministic. Each case is derived only from a confirmed local observation or an explicitly confirmed gate. Future execution must use fresh dedicated data, observe current authorization limits, and capture new evidence rather than treating this archive as an automated baseline.

## Test-case maintenance rules

Future QA should use a new asset prefix and preserve a per-case identity, exact URL, timestamp, visible feedback, persistence outcome and screenshot. A failed automation coordinate, a loading skeleton, an unconfirmed click, an unavailable browser capability, and a membership/age gate must stay `UNKNOWN`, `NOT_OBSERVED`, `CLEANUP_BLOCKED`, or `BLOCKED` as appropriate—not silently converted into a product failure.
